options.__comment_runs__: Glob over the run folders under paths.root_output (one folder per 01_calibration run, i.e. its data_output.folder_plot). '*' = every run.
options.__comment_run_labels__: Optional display names for run folders; unlisted runs are shown by folder name.
options.__comment_single_field__: 02_single_field.ipynb: which run/field/stage to show (null = first found / final stage).
options.__comment_irri__: Irrigation season as day-of-year bounds (match run_calibration.py's irrigation mask, DOY 90-270).
options.__comment_group_by__: 02_parameters.ipynb: optional shapefile attribute to group fields by (e.g. 'Crop'); group_map optionally maps its values to coarser classes.
